title: Output and head position during the copy pass
statement: Let $x$ and $w$ be finite Boolean strings, and let $t$ be a natural number with $t\le |x|$. Starting from the copy-state configuration on input $x$, with input head at position $1$ and output $w$, after exactly $t$ steps the machine remains in the copy state, its input head is at position $t+1$, and its output is $w$ followed by the first $t$ bits of $x$.
replaced:
Let $x$ be a bit string, $w$ an output string, and $t \le |x|$.  Running the
six-state diagonal pairing machine for exactly $t$ steps from the
configuration in its copy state (state $5$) with input head at position $1$
and output $w$ yields the configuration still in the copy state with input
head at position $t + 1$ and output $w$ followed by the first $t$ bits of
$x$.
